stem.en: Under whose initiative did the Government of India set up its real-time network of tsunami detection buoys?

feedback.en: IMD works with INCOIS on storm surges.
NCRMP works on cyclone shelters and warnings, not on tsunami buoys.
These monitor storms along the coasts.
Yes. The buoys were set up under an initiative of ITEWC.

explanation.en: The real-time network of tsunami detection buoys was set up under an initiative of the Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre (ITEWC). The buoys are designed to detect, measure and monitor tsunamis.

hints.en: Look for the body with the word tsunami in its name.
